data.title: Speed challenge: count the vowels
story: Write a function count_vowels(text) that counts the vowels (a, i, u, e, o) in a text.
Careful: there are hidden tests for capital letters and empty text!

explanation: Check every letter with for, and add to the count when the letter is in "aiueo". Turning the text to lowercase first with .lower() makes capital letters count too.
hints: Start with count = 0, then check each letter with for.
The expression letter in "aiueo" is True when the letter is a lowercase vowel.
Capital letters? Convert the text first with .lower().
